filament_settings_id: zz Generic PLA Fast @BBL X2D 0.6 nozzle
name: zz Generic PLA Fast @BBL X2D 0.6 nozzle
description: Personal preset - the 'zz' prefix sorts it last in the preset lists. Generic PLA with flow pushed for a 0.6 mm hotend: volumetric speed 36 on every variant (Bambu ships 12 for Generic PLA) and 235 C for the flow headroom that needs. Layer cooling cut to 4 s / 40 mm/s. Settled at 36 after 42 came out too aggressive. If walls still look thin or gaps appear between infill lines, drop toward 30-32 and lower the process speeds to match.
